purpose: Turn the validated 66-node frozen source index into a provenance-honest prerequisite/subskill graph without inventing ASQ-authored prerequisites, SME approval, learner outcomes, or newer-standard substitutions.

authority_model.source_bound_facts: Requirement identity, 2022 source locator, domain placement, and preserved cognitive level are SOURCE_BOUND_FROZEN facts and must not be rewritten by this topology step.
authority_model.owner_derived_structure: Prerequisite edges and subskill decompositions created by this step are LEARNING_OWNER_DERIVED_PROVISIONAL structure unless an exact evidence reference explicitly supports a stronger classification.
authority_model.human_outcomes: Retention, transfer, workplace effectiveness, psychometric validity, SME approval, certification equivalence, and learner mastery remain UNOBSERVED until separately evidenced.
authority_model.version_rule: No 2026 or later public revision may silently replace or reinterpret a frozen 2022 requirement node.

rules: Every PREREQUISITE edge must state the exact capability dependency that makes the target materially harder or invalid without the source capability.
Mere source order, domain order, Bloom/cognitive level, or numerical requirement order is insufficient by itself to create a hard prerequisite.
A provisional edge must retain LEARNING_OWNER_DERIVED_PROVISIONAL classification; it must not be described as ASQ-authored or SME-approved.
Every edge must reference both endpoint requirement/subskill identities and at least one exact rationale/evidence locator.
Uncertain dependency is represented as unresolved evidence work, not as a guessed edge.
A subskill must express one independently assessable capability necessary to satisfy its parent requirement.
Do not create a subskill solely to restate the parent requirement label.
Every subskill must be reachable from exactly one preserved requirement node through DECOMPOSES_TO.
Cross-requirement reuse is represented by prerequisite/reference edges; it must not create duplicate canonical subskill identities.
Assessment target status begins UNBOUND until a deterministic assessment contract is attached.

deterministic_derivation_sequence: Load the exact validated 66-node frozen source index and verify the requirement-set digest before transformation.

For each requirement, preserve source-bound fields byte-for-byte and create zero or more provisional subskills only where the preserved requirement meaning supports an independently assessable decomposition.
For each proposed prerequisite, record explicit dependency rationale and endpoint evidence; reject order-only or level-only prerequisites.

Run graph validation after every batch: unique identities, all endpoint resolution, acyclicity of PREREQUISITE, every subskill reachable, no orphan subskills, and no unauthorized source-version substitution.
Emit unresolved_dependency_candidates separately from accepted edges so ambiguity fails open for research but closed for canonical prerequisite admission.
Leave assessment/workplace/mastery/retention/transfer profiles unproven until their own evidence-bearing successors execute.

must_pass: 66 preserved requirement identities still present exactly once
all subskills have exactly one canonical parent requirement
every provisional edge/subskill carries derivation_class and evidence_refs
zero human-outcome fields are upgraded from UNOBSERVED without evidence

required_outputs: deterministic validator for the topology contract
validation evidence bound to an exact Learning subject SHA
next_work_contract.stop_condition: Stop canonical topology admission on any unresolved endpoint, unjustified hard prerequisite, cycle, orphan, provenance drift, version substitution, or human-evidence inference.

completion_delta: The 66-node population phase now has an executable, provenance-safe topology contract. The next worker can implement and validate graph structure without guessing that source order or cognitive level constitutes an authoritative prerequisite and without fabricating learner/SME evidence.
